name: FilterGalleryPanel
description: Session-bound effect candidates with worker-rendered thumbnails; selection commits an intercepted action.
signature: ({ session: provided, category, presets }: FilterGalleryPanelProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: category
props.description: Category to browse; omitted shows every filter.

props.name: presets
props.description: Show look/preset recipes instead of individual filters.

props.name: session
props.description: Session to edit; defaults to the nearest ImageEditorProvider.
